note: 绝对六轴角度保留原圈数。此记录用于比较起姿，现场软管状态、进场空间及安全性需单独确认。

pose_comparison.reference: Both tool comparisons use the identical world TCP pose. SolveIK_All receives the flange in robot base; the active reference is not applied.

verification.seeded: Additional native SolveIK calls with the captured anchor and each regular nominal analytic candidate as numerical seeds. Only independently verified native answers become classes; a seed is not an accepted answer.
verification.rlf_source: RoboDK JointsConfig. These bits are independent of the project branch indices.
verification.winding_count: Product of bounded absolute per-joint angle lifts. FK is rechecked at each closest representative and the explicit alternate J6 winding.
verification.angular_distance: L2 norm and maximum component of the absolute joint coordinate change, degrees. Comparisons use the recorded starting winding.
verification.scope: End-point FK and joint limits only; access path, collision and hose state were not evaluated.

class_selection: minimum feasible unwrapped L2 change from anchor
minimum modulo-360 L2 error vs archived q
largest elbow-origin displacement from nearest among remaining classes
